nodes.label: Testing skill how-to-apply workflow
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Read code, select rules, report defects before writing tests, run smallest test set, check review.md

nodes.label: Test observable behavior and application contracts
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.norm_label: test observable behavior and application contracts
nodes.rationale: A test must pass after an implementation change if behavior stays the same; cover every changed decision (branch, validation, calculation, authorization)

nodes.label: Laravel Cloud CLI (./vendor/bin/cloud)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use CLI rather than guessing dashboard/API workflows; project-local install preferred, global as fallback

nodes.label: Laravel Cloud Object Storage (Cloudflare R2)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: R2 applies visibility at bucket level, so private default disk + separate public bucket; no per-object visibility ACLs

nodes.label: Managed queues
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Recommended: dedicated autoscaling workers; scale-to-zero may interrupt long jobs

nodes.label: Resend email integration
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Domains verified in dashboard only; attach sets RESEND_API_KEY and MAIL_* vars; requires resend/resend-php

nodes.label: Cloud Secrets Manager
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Encrypted org-level values encrypted locally by CLI; pipe values in to avoid shell history; requires sodium; redeploy after changes

nodes.label: cloud usage billing queries
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Amounts in cents, camelCase keys

nodes.label: Build vs deploy commands
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Optimization/caching belongs in build; deploy (e.g. migrate --force) runs right before release; deploy filesystem changes not persisted; 15-minute timeout

nodes.label: CLI config precedence (LARAVEL_CLOUD_TOKEN, global, repo-local .cloud/config.json)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Env token overrides saved; CLI args override config files; multi-org needs organization_id

nodes.label: CLI flag combos (-n, --json, --force)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Always -n to avoid hanging; never -q/--silent since they suppress output

nodes.label: Cloud environments (production/staging/preview)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Each environment has its own compute, resources and deployment settings

nodes.label: Deploy then monitor workflow
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Always run deploy:monitor after every deploy; on failure read deployment:logs before fixing

nodes.label: Confirm destructive commands with user
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Deleting apps, environments, DBs, caches, buckets, domains, secrets or detaching Resend requires approval

nodes.label: Ephemeral environment filesystem
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Not shared between replicas and lost on deploy; use DB/Valkey for cache & sessions and Object Storage for files

nodes.label: Error loop rule (fix once, then ask)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.norm_label: error loop rule (fix once, then ask)
nodes.rationale: Avoid repeating failing operations; diagnose, fix once, ask user if it fails again

nodes.label: Forbidden deploy commands (queue:restart, horizon:terminate, optimize:clear, storage:link)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.norm_label: forbidden deploy commands (queue:restart, horizon:terminate, optimize:clear, storage:link)
nodes.rationale: Cloud handles worker restarts and process management; deploy filesystem changes are not persistent

nodes.label: Architecture choices are the gold
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Structural patterns (Actions, Services, DTOs, query objects) and deliberate absences are highest-signal

nodes.label: Skip tooling-owned forms (Pint/Rector)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Active tools rewrite code to canonical forms, so record only against-the-grain holds

nodes.label: Tailwind v4 @import "tailwindcss" syntax
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Replaces v3 @tailwind base/components/utilities directives

nodes.label: Tailwind v4 replaced deprecated utilities
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Opacity utilities become color modifiers (bg-blue-500/50); flex-shrink -> shrink etc.

nodes.label: Tailwind v4 CSS-first configuration (@theme)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Tailwind v4 is configured in CSS via @theme; no tailwind.config.js needed

nodes.label: Dark mode via dark: variant
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: New pages must support dark mode the same way existing ones do

nodes.label: Gap utilities for sibling spacing
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Use gap instead of margins between siblings

nodes.label: Consistency first (project test conventions take precedence)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.norm_label: consistency first (project test conventions take precedence)
nodes.rationale: Existing tests following a project convention are not defective; do not delete or rewrite, explain drawbacks and let user decide

nodes.label: Write a feature test first
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Unit tests only for logic that does not use the framework; laravel/dusk not installed so no real-browser tests

nodes.label: Cloud scheduler and onOneServer
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: schedule:run every minute; use onOneServer with multiple replicas

nodes.label: Decision rules (prefer framework features, avoid speculative abstractions)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.norm_label: decision rules (prefer framework features, avoid speculative abstractions)

nodes.label: How to apply (map concern to rule, smallest coherent change, verify with search-docs)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.norm_label: how to apply (map concern to rule, smallest coherent change, verify with search-docs)

nodes.label: Rule index (concern to rule file map)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.norm_label: rule index (concern to rule file map)

nodes.label: Subagent delegation for high-output commands
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Keep main context window small; verbose logs/JSON stay in subagent

nodes.label: Confirm vs yolo mode
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Conflicts always go to the user even in yolo

nodes.label: Consistency first (document reality, not improvements)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: The codebase majority style is the convention; never record what code should do

nodes.label: Record decisions, not defaults
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: A rule earns its place only if the next agent would plausibly write it differently

nodes.label: Evidence bar (3+ consistent examples, no meaningful rival)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.norm_label: evidence bar (3+ consistent examples, no meaningful rival)

nodes.label: Fan out checklist groups to subagents
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.norm_label: fan out checklist groups to subagents

nodes.label: Glob mapping for path-scoped rules
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Attach each rule to the most specific path covering its evidence; one record-rule call per glob

nodes.label: Infer-conventions process (Orient, Sweep, Open-ended, Confirm, Record, Summarize)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.norm_label: infer-conventions process (orient, sweep, open-ended, confirm, record, summarize)

nodes.label: Verdict types (Pattern, Conflict, Default, No signal, Tooling-owned, Already-recorded)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.norm_label: verdict types (pattern, conflict, default, no signal, tooling-owned, already-recorded)

nodes.label: Consistency first (follow existing codebase pattern)
nodes.author: laravel
nodes.rationale: Inconsistency is worse than a suboptimal pattern; rules are defaults when no pattern exists

nodes.label: Testing validation through behavior
nodes.rationale: Assert user-visible message text; do not assert rule arrays; use #[DataProvider]/#[TestWith]

nodes.label: PHPUnit/Laravel feature search table
nodes.rationale: DataProvider, Depends, Group, RequiresPhp, --order-by=random, ParaTest, --stop-on-failure

nodes.label: Parallel testing with ParaTest (php artisan test --parallel)
nodes.norm_label: parallel testing with paratest (php artisan test --parallel)
nodes.rationale: Each process gets its own database; tests must create their own records, be order-independent, not share resources

nodes.label: Public static data providers with descriptive keys
nodes.norm_label: public static data providers with descriptive keys
nodes.rationale: Use for enum cases, roles, boundaries; separate tests when setup/behavior differs

nodes.label: Time and randomness control (freezeTime, travelTo, Sleep::fake)
nodes.norm_label: time and randomness control (freezetime, travelto, sleep::fake)
nodes.rationale: Tests depending on real time, randomness, sleep or network fail for unrelated reasons

nodes.label: Each test makes its own data (no records in setUp)
nodes.norm_label: each test makes its own data (no records in setup)
nodes.rationale: Setup stays visible; setUp objects remain in memory until suite ends

nodes.label: Named factory states, for(), recycle(), sequence()
nodes.norm_label: named factory states, for(), recycle(), sequence()
nodes.rationale: Named state gives data meaning; create() only when DB needed, make() otherwise

nodes.label: AuditLogger
nodes.rationale: Every sensitive operation (create, update, approve, pay, permission change) is audited; passwords are never logged.

nodes.label: No Hardcoded Values / No Secrets in Git
nodes.norm_label: no hardcoded values / no secrets in git

nodes.label: Controller / FormRequest / Service / Model Layering
nodes.rationale: Controllers only receive/return; FormRequests validate; Services own business rules, transactions and auditing; no direct queries in controllers.

nodes.label: Module Structure app/Modules/<Name>
nodes.rationale: Each module holds Models, Services, Http, Database, Routes, Providers, Policies; modules share one DB but never read another module's tables directly, communicating via Services or Events.

nodes.label: Source IP Allowlist and Trusted Network Requirement
nodes.norm_label: source ip allowlist and trusted network requirement
nodes.rationale: SN and IP allowlist are not cryptographic device auth; deployment requires VPN preserving device addresses, middleware ignores X-Forwarded-For to prevent IP spoofing, and trustProxies('*') must not be used.

nodes.label: Privilege Escalation Protection
nodes.rationale: No one grants or revokes beyond what they hold; last active system admin cannot be removed; role edits are audited and version-guarded (409).

nodes.label: AccessTest Coverage Test
nodes.rationale: Fails if a registered permission is unused or code checks an unregistered permission.

nodes.label: Grant Scopes (all, department, own)
nodes.rationale: When a permission comes from several roles, the widest scope wins.

nodes.label: Department Manager Inferred from hr_departments.manager_employee_id
nodes.rationale: Role is not assigned manually and is revoked as soon as the department manager changes.

nodes.label: Permission System
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth in code; roles are editable records; no per-user exceptions; business logic never names roles.

nodes.label: Arrange, act, assert
nodes.rationale: Separate setup, one action, assertions with blank lines; tests self-contained

nodes.label: Framework fakes (Event/Queue/Mail/Exceptions::fake)
nodes.rationale: Create fakes inside each test, not setUp(); pass class names; create factory records before Event::fake()

nodes.label: How to Find Test Framework Features
nodes.norm_label: how to find test framework features

nodes.label: Assert the complete result of write operations
nodes.norm_label: assert the complete result of write operations
nodes.rationale: Status alone is not the result; assert response, DB state, dispatched jobs/events, notifications/mail; assert none on failure path

nodes.label: Assert a known value
nodes.rationale: Computing expected value with implementation logic makes the test pass when that logic is wrong

nodes.label: assertSame() over assertEquals()
nodes.rationale: assertSame also compares type

nodes.label: Named response assertions (assertNotFound vs assertStatus(404))
nodes.rationale: A failure then identifies the broken contract

nodes.label: Built-in Laravel assertion methods
nodes.rationale: Hand-built checks fail with 'false is not true'; framework assertions name the incorrect table/value

nodes.label: ATTLOG Tab-Separated Punch Format
nodes.rationale: Raw request and punches are stored in one transaction before replying OK so the device retries on storage failure; dedupe key derived from the punch line.

nodes.label: Effective-Dated Attendance Policy Versions
nodes.rationale: New policy versions only from tomorrow onward and never rewrite past days, to protect history.

nodes.label: overtime_multiplier Policy Setting
nodes.rationale: Stored for the future payroll phase only; no double deduction for lateness and reduced work hours.

nodes.label: Leave/Attendance Overlap Fix
nodes.rationale: Approved leave overlap is excluded from late/early periods before rounding, grace and late blocks; approved days keep old numbers and are flagged as pending changes.

nodes.label: Manual QA Scenarios for Partial Leave Attendance
nodes.norm_label: manual qa scenarios for partial leave attendance

nodes.label: completed_blocks Grace Mode (45 min grace, 60 min blocks)
nodes.norm_label: completed_blocks grace mode (45 min grace, 60 min blocks)
nodes.rationale: After grace, completed late blocks counted from shift start with minimum one block; compares actual seconds; V1 modes threshold_full and excess_only remain for old policies.

nodes.label: Native ADMS/PUSH Gateway for iFace 880 Plus
nodes.norm_label: native adms/push gateway for iface 880 plus
nodes.rationale: The device initiates the connection and pushes punches/pulls commands; Laravel never connects to device port 4370, so no laptop bridge is needed when ADMS reaches the server directly.

nodes.label: Remote Fingerprint Enrollment Workflow (USERINFO / ENROLL_FP)
nodes.rationale: Experimental and guarded: states queued_user -> await_user_ack -> queued_enroll -> await_enroll_ack -> awaiting_physical_verification -> manually_confirmed; biometric_verified stays false since the server never verifies the template.

nodes.label: Dated Device User Bindings (device_user_id)
nodes.rationale: Text, per-device and effective-dated binding replaces numeric biometric_code so leading zeros are kept and punches are never attributed to the wrong employee.

nodes.label: Attendance System V2 (Grace and Late Blocks)
nodes.norm_label: attendance system v2 (grace and late blocks)

nodes.label: Manual Device Sync Confirmation (confirm-sync / complete_through)
nodes.rationale: complete_through is never advanced from heartbeat or ATTLOG batches because the protocol does not guarantee historical completeness; an attendance admin confirms explicitly.

nodes.label: Device connection_mode (adms | bridge)
nodes.rationale: Once switched to adms the device rejects the legacy JSON device-ingest so an old bridge token cannot bypass ADMS guarantees.

nodes.label: Day Approval, Bulk Approval and Reopen (pending_changes)
nodes.norm_label: day approval, bulk approval and reopen (pending_changes)
nodes.rationale: Approved days are never overwritten; later differences surface as pending_changes until HR reopens.

nodes.label: Bridge JSON device-ingest Endpoint
nodes.rationale: Stable external_id per source event for idempotency; complete_through is a bridge pledge that all records were sent, never inferred from last punch.

nodes.label: Device Token (SHA-256 hashed, separate from Sanctum)
nodes.norm_label: device token (sha-256 hashed, separate from sanctum)

nodes.label: Context facade for request-scoped data
nodes.rationale: Propagates to logs and queued jobs; addHidden for non-logged data

nodes.label: Exception report/render location (methods vs bootstrap/app.php callbacks)
nodes.norm_label: exception report/render location (methods vs bootstrap/app.php callbacks)
nodes.rationale: Follow the project's existing pattern

nodes.label: View composers for shared view data
nodes.norm_label: view composers for shared view data
nodes.rationale: Run only on view rendering, not JSON responses

nodes.label: Keep queries out of Blade templates
nodes.norm_label: keep queries out of blade templates

nodes.label: Locked-Month Payroll Adjustments
nodes.rationale: Compares against the Finance-applied amount, not the auto proposal, so waivers are not silently reversed.

nodes.label: Payroll Calculation Rules (unpaid leave, overtime, late, absence)
nodes.norm_label: payroll calculation rules (unpaid leave, overtime, late, absence)

nodes.label: Payroll Module API
nodes.rationale: HR prepares the run and proposes items, Finance decides each item and approves, then pays via Sham Cash.

nodes.label: No Implicit Acceptance of Payroll Items
nodes.norm_label: no implicit acceptance of payroll items
nodes.rationale: Proposed deductions, HR items and adjustments count as zero until Finance decides explicitly; approval rejected (409) while undecided items exist; nobody approves a run they created.

nodes.label: cursor() vs lazy() iteration
nodes.rationale: cursor cannot eager load; lazy chunks with eager loading

nodes.label: lazyById() when updating while iterating
nodes.rationale: Offset pagination can skip/duplicate rows

nodes.label: toQuery() for bulk collection operations
nodes.rationale: Does not fire per-model events

nodes.label: Attendance Correction Request and Review
nodes.rationale: No one reviews their own request, even a system admin; a new source after the request blocks accepting the stale one with 409.

nodes.label: In-App Notifications (leave.*, attendance.*)
nodes.rationale: Notifications sent only after successful operations.

nodes.label: Board Types (personal, team, department, project)
nodes.rationale: Invisible boards return 404 to avoid hinting at existence; insufficient role returns 403; personal boards are private even from the company manager.

nodes.label: Card Completion Cycle (done -> owner approve -> finished)
nodes.norm_label: card completion cycle (done -> owner approve -> finished)

nodes.label: Laravel Boost Bootstrap Guidelines (AGENTS.md)
nodes.rationale: Placeholder agent instructions: verify PHP/Composer, then install Laravel Boost which replaces these with app-tailored guidelines.

nodes.label: Attendance and devices module
nodes.rationale: /iclock/* and /attendance/device-ingest are device-only

nodes.norm_label: breaking changes table for the old frontend

nodes.rationale: Use localhost not 127.0.0.1 because token is stored per origin

nodes.norm_label: finance.approve required for reversals and invoice cancellation

nodes.norm_label: finance module (accounts, entries, boxes, transactions, invoices, reports)

nodes.rationale: Build on it, do not create a parallel layer

nodes.norm_label: hr module (departments, job titles, employees, contracts, documents)

nodes.norm_label: identity, users, access and settings endpoints

nodes.rationale: submission_key UUID generated once per request and resent on retry for idempotency

nodes.norm_label: local run and per-screen verification checklist

nodes.rationale: Live spec + code win over this document on conflict

nodes.norm_label: unified response envelope {data, meta, links} and error {message, errors}

nodes.norm_label: sanctum bearer-token auth (7-day expiry, revoked on disable/password change)

nodes.norm_label: sham cash xlsx export with x-doc-id header

nodes.rationale: Server computes effective permissions; delete frontend logic rebuilding them from role names (core/access/accounts.ts)

nodes.norm_label: frontend (angular) to backend (laravel) integration guide - eoms

nodes.label: Backend is the source of truth (golden rule)
nodes.norm_label: backend is the source of truth (golden rule)
nodes.rationale: Never modify eos-backend; adapt the frontend and report gaps instead of patching around them

nodes.label: Authenticated blob downloads with Content-Disposition
nodes.rationale: Downloads need Authorization header so <a href> cannot be used

nodes.label: Dates and money as strings; leave units as integers
nodes.norm_label: dates and money as strings; leave units as integers
nodes.rationale: new Date().toISOString() shifts date-only values back a day due to UTC; decimal strings avoid float errors

nodes.rationale: No one grants broader permission/scope than they hold; last active system admin cannot be removed

nodes.norm_label: four-eyes rule (no self-approval of own records)

nodes.norm_label: full environment setup checklist (app + db + cache + domain)

nodes.norm_label: new app from scratch checklist (cloud ship)

nodes.norm_label: accessors/mutators dimension (attribute class vs legacy getxxxattribute)

nodes.norm_label: php conventions (curly braces, constructor promotion, return types)

nodes.rationale: Lease must exceed callback runtime
